ranked_facts.concept_key: Immunohistochemical studies showing strong immunoreactivity for CD31, CD99, and Fli-1
ranked_facts.why: The strong immunoreactivity for CD31, CD99, and Fli-1 is more characteristic of Meningeal Sarcoma with Angiosarcomatous Features, which cannot be explained by the other candidates.

ranked_facts.concept_key: Histopathological examination showing spindle cells forming masses with branching ectatic vasculature
ranked_facts.why: The histopathological findings of spindle cells forming masses with branching ectatic vasculature are more typical of Meningeal Sarcoma with Angiosarcomatous Features, which is not a characteristic feature of the other candidates.
